thread:
javier: Quick proposal for region routing: introduce an opt-in header `X-Region-Prefer` (values: primary|secondary|any) that edge can set based on geo affinity. Policy: honour header unless measured latency to the preferred region > 200ms then fail over to secondary. Sketch below — wants feedback, esp. security/telemetry implications. :thinking:

sasha: I don't love trusting client headers. Edge should emit that header server-side after verifying geo/latency. Otherwise customers could spoof to dodge quotas.

mila: Agreed. Also need per-request telemetry to detect route flapping. We should log origin-edge, chosen-region, measured-rt, decision-reason. Small overhead but necessary.

zara: From console/rollout POV: do we expose this as a per-route toggle (safe) or as a global default with per-route overrides? My vote: per-route toggle + global fallback. We should support canary percent and gradual increase.

javier: Ok per-route toggle + global default. For rollout UX we can reuse the existing rollout panel: add an inner switch + percentage slider labeled "Region preference enforcement". If disabled, router ignores `X-Region-Prefer`. If enabled, we evaluate header and latency threshold.

javier: Example router rule (staging PoC):
```json
{
  "match": "/v1/chat*",
  "region_policy": {
    "enabled": true,
    "header": "X-Region-Prefer",
    "threshold_ms": 200,
    "fallback_order": ["eu-west-1","us-east-1","ap-south-1"]
  }
}
```

sasha: A few notes: (1) we need signed edge headers - see infra spec for X-Edge-Sig, (2) threshold should be adaptive per-customer SLA, not hard-coded, (3) add metric tags so billing/quotas can attribute token cost to actual region used.

mila: For telemetry naming: route.region_decision{route=/v1/chat, preferred=eu-west-1, chosen=us-east-1, reason=latency, rt=312, shard=dedicated-42}. That will help automatic rollback if error rates or latencies spike.

zara: UX: show a tiny histogram in the route page with preferred vs served region over the rollout window plus a rollback CTA when error/latency > guardrail.

infra-bot: Policy feature branch deployed to staging: refs/heads/region-pref-header. Integration tests queued.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for service=router-staging, policy=region-pref-header, pct=5% :rocket:

javier: Next steps: (1) infra to add signed header and adaptive threshold hook, (2) metrics to be named as above, (3) devex to draft console UX copy for rollout and rollback. I'll open a short RFC and link here. :+1:
